notes: rules: Fernhollow's house rules as a Charter would carry them in x_checks_rules (draft 1, 2026-10-22).
cases: element gives a body as a reader might hold it; expect gives, per rule index, 'ok', 'short' or 'out' (not scoped); a rule index absent from expect is not applied to that case.
not_checked: rules a reader must report by name, never apply and never pass silently; reason is prose, a reader's words may differ.

stubs: an element marked known_of: true (folder spec 4.4) is judged by no rule and counted in no rule's scoped; its absent fields are unknown, not short, and a filled field does not bring it in (serial 64).
measured: the counts the reference reader printed on Fernhollow's live world on 2026-10-22 (37 Characters, 24 Relations), the specimen's receipt, not a verdict a reader must reproduce.

rules.rule: a live line carries its Next
a Funding line names the roles
the first line of a description is Source: ... · as of YYYY-MM-DD
a line's status is one the Charter names
a person or an organisation says where it stands

cases.name: a Character with an empty reputation
a Character with a null reputation
a live Funding line with Next and roles and a Source line

element.description:
Source: mail from Bram · as of 2026-05-26
Roles: Jasper leads.
Next: the meeting on 11-02.

Source: x · as of 2026-01-01
Going well.

cases.name: an ended line is not scoped by the Next rule
the subtype compared folded and trimmed
Next in the middle of a line is not the form
a status the Charter does not name
a Read relation is outside the status rule
a single link counts as one
a description that is not a string never matches
where.type as a list: an institution is scoped
where.type as a list: a character is scoped too
where.type as a list: an object is not
where.type as a list: each listed type compared folded
a known-of stub is judged by no rule
a known-of stub with its fields filled is still out

rule.rule: a type the schema does not name
a field the type does not have

not_checked.reason: not a field of character and not an extension key

rule.rule: an extension key is always a field

not_checked.reason: a rule must be an object

rule.rule: a type list with one name the schema does not name

not_checked.reason: unknown type: one unknown name leaves the whole rule not checked
where.type is a string or a non-empty list of strings

rule.rule: a field one listed type does not have

not_checked.reason: the field must be a field of every listed type, or an extension key
